opening.argument: The presentation focuses on phone-based ways to earn: taking pictures, choosing listed store tasks, receiving cashback, answering surveys, and performing local services. It describes what users would do in those apps, while its earning figures remain reported claims that the available evidence cannot independently verify. The request for comments and direction to additional material fit audience engagement and course promotion; neither establishes deception on its own. The available evidence does not show required financial participation, credential collection, victim loss, or a completed harmful outcome. On that record, the presentation is an educational discussion of apps and tasks, not evidence of a completed fraud.
